scenes.name: Cold Open

chapter.zh: 序幕 · 零摄影机，四重尺度

ledger: 2026-11-28 · 539 repositories · ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. 243 (Volumes I, II, IV) · The Omega Institute, independent, 296 (Volume III)
lines: Look at this room in Singapore.
看看这间新加坡办公室。
Zero cameras behind the glass.
玻璃后面没有一台摄影机。
Zero agencies polishing a single word.
没有公关公司润色过半个字。
Of the 539 repositories, 243 are commercial and engineering repositories at ChronoAI Pte. Ltd.
539 座仓库中，ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. 有 243 座商业与工程仓。
The other 296 belong to The Omega Institute, an independent research body.
其余 296 座属于独立科研机构 The Omega Institute。
Two live 3D worlds take us from the office to the Institute’s 223,231 machine-checked theorems.
两座实时 3D 世界带我们从办公室来到研究院的 223,231 条机器核验定理前。
The cost of execution just collapsed toward zero.
执行的成本刚刚塌向零。
Now listen with a hammer to what actually holds weight.
现在拿铁锤听一听，什么才真正压得住阵脚。

scenes.name: Through the Glass
ledger: 60 days · 141,624 commits across 74 active repositories
1,108 seats · 4 stands × 8 rows · 18 flower mats
Nov 27 · Donna · 13 booking and check-in operations · 0 dropped seats · median 29 s
lines: Start at Donna's front desk.
从 Donna 的前台开始。
Eighteen flower mats line the way to Flower Town.
十八块花篮垫位沿路排开，转角就是鲜花小镇。
The November 27 rehearsal ran thirteen booking and check-in operations.
十一月二十七日的彩排完成了十三次订座与签到操作。
Donna dropped no seats and responded in a median of 29 seconds.
Donna 没有漏掉一个席位，中位响应时间为 29 秒。
Pull through the glass to four floating stands, each with eight rows.
穿过玻璃幕墙，四座悬空看台各有八排座位。
Atomic locks protect all 1,108 seats above the bay.
海湾上空的 1,108 个席位，每个都有原子锁。
In 60 days, about fifteen engineers and their agents landed 141,624 commits across 74 active repositories.
六十天里，约十五位工程师与代理在 74 座活跃仓库提交了 141,624 次。
Never clap for volume alone.
别只为数量鼓掌。
A flood has volume.
洪水也有数量。

scenes.name: Marina Bay to Orbit
ledger: chrono-metaverse · 15 live broadcast craft across bay and orbit · 252.8 m Sky-Screen · 5,307 km orbital screen
lines: Climb past the stadium and bank over Marina Bay Sands.
拉升越过剧场，再侧身掠过滨海湾金沙。
Watch the fifteen live broadcast craft across bay and orbit.
看横跨海湾与轨道的十五架实时飞行器。
Daylight melts into neon across Singapore's skyline.
白昼在新加坡天际线滑入夜色霓虹。
Keep climbing until the bay shrinks beneath the 5,307-kilometer orbital screen.
继续攀升，直到整片海湾缩成 5,307 公里轨道大屏下的一点微光。
Four physical scales share one unbroken live signal.
四重物理尺度共用一路连续的实时信号。
Now leave Earth's atmosphere.
现在冲出大气层。
Marketing slogans suffocate in vacuum.
营销口号会在真空中窒息。
Out here, you can still check the proof.
到了这里，你依然可以核查证明。

scenes.name: Eight Stations

chapter.en: Act I — The Omega Institute: Eight Stations into Proof
chapter.zh: 第一幕 · The Omega Institute：穿越星穹，直抵内核

ledger: trureturing @ 548388cd · 223,231 frozen Lean 4 theorems · 17,968 modules · 6.02M LOC
720/720 UTC hours · median 63 commits/hr
2,278 literature resolutions · 1,512 proved / 766 refuted · journals 358 proved + 326 refuted = 684
8 orbital stations · 500 relay arcs · 8 spiral galaxies · 19,022 truth nodes
lines: Welcome to the independent research observatory of The Omega Institute.
欢迎来到独立科研机构 The Omega Institute 的观测站。
At live.trureturing.org, you can inspect the work as it happens.
在 live.trureturing.org，你能看到正在进行的工作。
Send a radar sweep across eight orbital stations.
一道雷达扫频掠过八座空间站。
Dive through the formal verification bridge into eight spiral galaxies with 19,022 truth nodes.
穿过形式验证主桥，飞入共有 19,022 个真值节点的八座螺旋星系。
For 720 straight hours the median was 63 commits an hour.
连续 720 小时，每小时提交数的中位数为 63。
The observatory holds 223,231 frozen Lean 4 theorems.
观测站收录了 223,231 条冻结的 Lean 4 定理。
Of 2,278 problems from the literature, some have proofs and others have counterexamples.
2,278 道文献问题得到解决，有的得到了证明，有的找到了反例。

scenes.name: The Lean Kernel
ledger: Fredkin witness · 2.00034 ebits · propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound · sorryAx: 0
ANALOGY · Feynman ratchet
trureturing-books · 344 bilingual pages/language · 83 films · 2,043 distinct theorems
lines: Never trust a narrator.
别信旁白。
Walk to the blackboard and inspect the chalk.
走到黑板前，查查粉笔字。
A 2025 Physical Review A conjecture put a two-ebit ceiling on the four-qubit Fredkin gate.
论文猜想四量子比特 Fredkin 门的纠缠上限为 2 ebits。
One explicit witness exceeds that ceiling at 2.00034 ebits.
一个显式反例达到了 2.00034 ebits，越过了这道上限。
Run #print axioms in Lean 4.
在 Lean 4 中运行 #print axioms。
It returns propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, with zero sorryAx.
结果只有三条标准公理，sorryAx 为零。
For an analogy, picture Feynman's tiny ratchet and pawl.
打个比方，想想费曼的微型棘轮和棘爪。
One frozen theorem shows how new truth narrows illusion.
一条冻结定理说明新真理如何缩小错觉空间。
The other tells us when old knowledge cannot count as new.
另一条说明，什么情况下旧知识不能再算作新发现。

scenes.name: Red Ink
ledger: 1,049 scholars contacted · 485 replied · 17 arXiv · 21 OEIS · 66 declined
mathesis-papers · 225 open papers · 0 formal peer-review acceptances
Nov 20 · Levent Alpöge released his five-theorem Lean 4.33.1 proof of classical RiemannHypothesis and Dirichlet GRH
Nov 21 · Lean/Mathlib communities certified classical RiemannHypothesis · independent five-theorem audits checked Dirichlet GRH
the-omega-institute/riemann-hypothesis · 8,490-shard ./verify replay · trureturing proves only the integer Hankel equivalence
OPEN · Extended RH · Grand RH · zero simplicity · pair correlation
lines: This is where a launch usually cuts the camera.
发布会讲到这里，通常就切镜头了。
We stamp the bruises in crimson beside the trophies.
我们把缺口用朱红印在奖杯旁边。
Of the 1,049 scholars contacted, 485 replied and 66 declined.
我们联络了 1,049 位学者，485 位回信，66 位婉拒。
Mathesis hosts 225 open papers with machine-checkable sources.
Mathesis 已收录 225 篇开源论文，附有可机器核查的源文件。
The count of formal peer-review acceptances is still zero.
正式同行评审录用数仍为零。
On November 20, Levent Alpöge released his Lean 4 proof.
11 月 20 日，Levent Alpöge 发布了他的 Lean 4 证明。
It covers classical RH and Dirichlet GRH.
这份证明涵盖经典黎曼猜想与狄利克雷广义黎曼猜想。
On November 21, the Lean and Mathlib communities certified classical RH.
11 月 21 日，Lean 与 Mathlib 社区认证了经典黎曼猜想。
Independent audits checked all five theorems, including Dirichlet GRH.
独立审计核查了全部五条定理，其中包括狄利克雷广义黎曼猜想。
The Omega Institute built the 8,490-shard replay.
The Omega Institute 构建了 8,490 分片重放工程。
Extended RH, Grand RH, zero simplicity and pair correlation remain open.
扩展 RH、大 RH、零点单重性与对关联猜想仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: The Complete Vehicle

chapter.en: Act II — ChronoAI: The Complete Vehicle Live
chapter.zh: 第二幕 · ChronoAI：整车实测，零密钥底座

ledger: ANALOGY · engine and vehicle · hotel keycard
NyxID v0.78.0 · 55 services · 42 MCP specs · 0 plaintext keys
lines: Step back into daylight and lift the hood.
走回白昼，掀开引擎盖。
Think of renting a five-hundred-horsepower engine by the token.
打个比方，你可以按 token 租一台五百马力的发动机。
Bolt it to wet concrete without brakes and the first tap of throttle sends metal flying.
没有刹车，只把它固定在湿水泥上，第一脚油门就会让碎铁四溅。
ChronoAI builds the complete vehicle around an engine you can swap tomorrow.
ChronoAI 造的是一辆整车，明天还能换发动机。
Watch NyxID work like a hotel keycard.
看 NyxID 如何像酒店房卡那样工作。
It opens room 412 until noon and never touches the master safe.
它只开 412 房，到中午失效，碰不到总保险柜。
NyxID serves 55 services with 42 live MCP specs.
NyxID 接入 55 项服务，提供 42 份线上 MCP 规范。
Watch one-command revocation cut off access.
看一条吊销命令如何切断访问。
No plaintext keys ever enter an agent's prompt.
明文密钥从未进入代理的提示词。

scenes.name: The Running Stack
ledger: Ornn v0.18.0 · 163 scanned skills · 134 ops
CMA v0.12.0 · Apache-2.0 · 2.1 s hot credential reload
heca · 27 integrations · 360 nightlies
chrono-harness · 25 public repos · 21 Rust binaries/platform · 540 Verus proofs · Copier v0.1.52
lines: Stack the rest of the vehicle live.
接着装上整车的其他部件。
Ornn turns prompts into 163 scanned, versioned skills you can call like an API.
Ornn 把提示词做成 163 项经扫描的版本化技能，可以像 API 那样调用。
Apache-licensed CMA v0.12.0 runs hosted agents in isolated sandboxes.
按 Apache 许可开源的 CMA v0.12.0 在隔离沙箱里托管代理。
Credentials reload in 2.1 seconds.
凭据可在 2.1 秒内热重载。
The local canvas heca spans 27 agent integrations and 360 nightly builds.
本地画布 heca 支持 27 类代理集成，已发布 360 个夜间版本。
At github.com/chrono-harness, 25 public repositories replace prompt checklists with executable checks.
github.com/chrono-harness 有 25 座公开仓库供核查。
They ship 21 executable Rust judges and 540 Verus proofs.
其中有 21 个可执行的 Rust 判官与 540 份 Verus 证明。

scenes.name: Unfinished Steel
ledger: heca source repository private · CMA single primary coding runtime · chrono-harness completeness_proven: false
lines: Every spotless brochure hides its weld marks.
光鲜的手册藏起了焊痕。
Look at three unfinished bolts on our workbench.
看看工作台上三颗还没拧紧的螺丝。
The heca source is still private.
heca 的源码仍为私有。
CMA runs one primary coding runtime today.
CMA 目前只跑一个主编码运行时。
In chrono-harness, completeness_proven still reads false.
completeness_proven 至今仍是 false。
Take the caliper and check the work in Volume Two.
拿起游标卡尺，翻开第二卷，自己来量。

scenes.name: Nine Roles

chapter.en: Act III — Handing the Launch to Nine AI Employees
chapter.zh: 第三幕 · 把发布会交给九位 AI 员工

ledger: 9 standalone AI roles · 102/120 workflows (85.0%) · HR 15 → 14/20 · #9 Retrospective Analyst 11/11
Nov 27 dress rehearsal · 11/12 first try · 4 human taps · Donna median 29 s · NyxID #2534 stalled 65 min, 3 min bypass
Launch Arena · 432/1,108 seated · 0 duplicate seats vs 105 naive
0 external paying merchants · first pilot opens Dec 17
lines: A neighborhood bakery does not need to refute a quantum conjecture.
街角烘焙店用不着反驳量子猜想。
On Monday morning, nine disciplined roles cover 102 of 120 workflows.
周一早上，九个守规矩的岗位覆盖了 120 项流程中的 102 项。
At the cash register, they wait for a human to turn the key.
到了收银台，它们等着人类来拧钥匙。
Our audit knocked HR down from 15 to 14 out of 20 when PDF parsing hit its limits.
PDF 解析触及边界，HR 覆盖从 20 项中的 15 项调回 14 项。
On November 27, we rehearsed all twelve stages.
十一月二十七日，我们进行了全流程彩排。
Eleven of twelve passed on the first try, with four human taps.
十二关全流程彩排一次闯过十一关，人类仅动手四次。
One queue stalled for 65 minutes in NyxID issue #2534.
NyxID 的 #2534 号问题记录了队列停滞的 65 分钟。
A three-minute bypass cleared it.
启用旁路后，三分钟便疏通了队列。
The number of external paying merchants today is zero.
今天上线的外部付费商户为零。
Our first pilot cohort opens on December 17.
首批商户试点于十二月十七日开放申请。

scenes.name: Return Flight

chapter.zh: 终幕 · 双境合一，拿起粉笔

ledger: 8 spiral galaxies · 5,307 km orbit · 252.8 m Sky-Screen · 1,108-seat Tide Arena
lines: Pull back across both worlds from eight galaxies of frozen mathematics.
从收录冻结定理的八座星系拉远镜头，再看这两座世界。
Drop through Earth orbit into Marina Bay's glowing arena.
穿过地球轨道，回到流光溢彩的滨海湾剧场。
For Nietzsche, strength meant giving form to chaos.
在尼采看来，力量是给混沌赋予形式。
Feynman's first rule was to never fool yourself.
费曼的第一条规矩是，绝不能欺骗自己。
After all, you are the easiest person for you to fool.
毕竟，你最容易骗过的人就是自己。
What grows rarer with every sunrise is the courage to show the whole structure.
每过一个清晨，愈发稀缺的是敢把整个结构亮出来的勇气。
Lay the code, the proofs, the downgrades and the open seams side by side in the sun.
把代码、证明、降级记录和未完的接缝一起摊在阳光下。

scenes.name: Pick Up the Chalk
ledger: ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. · chrono-ai.fun · Street Corner · Dec 17 16:00 SGT · contact@chrono-ai.fun
The Omega Institute · independent · live.trureturing.org · trureturing-books · mathesis-papers
lines: Step into Street Corner on December 17 at four p.m. Singapore time.
十二月十七日新加坡时间下午四点，推开街角前厅的门。
Audit any green theorem at live.trureturing.org.
到 live.trureturing.org 抽检任意一条绿标定理。
Open the four monographs or write to contact@chrono-ai.fun.
翻开这四部专著，或致信 contact@chrono-ai.fun。
Pick up the chalk and build for what comes next.
拿起粉笔，面向未来去造物。
